What you will do:

  • In partnership with VF nominated Asia Product teams, you will represent commercialization in all early PD cycle product review meetings and use your SME production knowledge to ensure viability of development samples to commercialization requirements.

  • Ability to operate on your own or within a cross-functional, multi cultural team and be seen as a positive contributor.

  • A strong understanding of paper patterns creation and an understanding of digital product creation will be a strong advantage.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Engineer in Sourcing Development for Footwear, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of development samples and meeting milestone dates according to the product creation calendar. You will manage commercialization timelines, coordinate Tier 2 activities at assigned factories, and ensure engineering for productivity, product quality, integrity, and performance in line with brand policies and best practices.

You will support VF’s product strategic initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure production quality, on-time performance, and compliance with VF standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Development & Commercialization

  • Manage development processes with Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors across all sample stages
  • Inspect development samples, including sales samples across countries of origin
  • Conduct activities related to new bottoms, uppers, color-ups, fit approval, material testing, wear testing, swatch sign-off, and cost approval
  • Plan Buy Ready process by SKU
  • Communicate product and performance requirements to vendors
  • Solve issues related to construction, performance, costing, and process
  • Coordinate factory capacity and material purchasing aligned with production calendar
  • Review tech package information and confirm pattern grading and tooling readiness
  • Confirm sample size patterns and molds for salesman samples
  • Assist in building production specifications
  • Propose and implement cost-saving, efficiency, automation, and quality improvement ideas
  • Conduct Tech 2 trials and confirm fit and wear testing
  • Introduce new products and cascade quality risks during tear-down and NPI meetings

Pre-Production & Production

  • Provide support as needed during pre-production and production phases

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Deep technical knowledge of footwear categories and material properties
  • Basic knowledge of automation and computer stitching for upper pattern construction
  • General knowledge of last making, measurements, and mold/bottom checking
  • Ability to integrate technical applications without compromising design or cost
  • Ability to identify product quality and integrity risks and recommend corrective actions
  • Strong relationship-building skills with factories and cross-functional teams
  • Branded footwear experience required
  • Alignment with VF’s guiding principles: Integrity, Courage, Curiosity, Empathy, Perseverance

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in product development, commercialization, pre-production, and production in footwear or related fields within a multinational company
  • Good command of English and strong communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Travel: As required

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:


As Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sustainable commercial growth across the region while protecting the premium positioning and long-term equity of ARC’TERYX. You will shape and execute the regional wholesale strategy, developing strategic partnerships with leading outdoor specialty, mountain, trail running and premium sporting goods retailers. You will have the opportunity to build and strengthen a high-performing regional sales organization while creating new structures, processes and commercial opportunities across diverse EMEA markets. Working across countries, channels and cultures, you will navigate the complexity of balancing ambitious growth objectives with disciplined distribution and exceptional brand presentation. This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in growing the ARC’TERYX footwear business and strengthening our credibility within the outdoor community through authentic retail partnerships, technical expertise and meaningful consumer experiences.
This role can be hired remote. Business operations occur on Central European Time (CET/CEST) and extensive travel throughout EMEA is required.

Meet Your Future Team:


The EMEA Wholesale team is responsible for building strong, long-term partnerships with our retail and distribution network while delivering sustainable commercial growth across the region. Working collaboratively across markets, functions and channels, the team is focused on strengthening our premium distribution, elevating the consumer experience and ensuring ARC’TERYX products are represented with authenticity and excellence.

If you were in the Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Developing and executing the EMEA wholesale footwear strategy in alignment with global business objectives and regional market opportunities
  • Building and strengthening long-term partnerships with leading outdoor specialty retailers, mountain shops, trail running specialists, premium sporting goods retailers and selected omnichannel partners
  • Leading and developing regional sales representatives, Key Account Managers, Area Sales Managers, Technical Representatives and agencies to deliver a high-performance, partnership-led sales culture
  • Managing commercial planning across markets and strategic accounts, including annual agreements, Joint Business Plans, seasonal pre-orders, in-season replenishment and sell-through performance
  • Collaborating cross-functionally and across international markets to optimize assortments, forecasting, inventory productivity, merchandising standards and future collection strategies

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Delivering sustainable double-digit growth across priority EMEA markets while protecting premium distribution and long-term brand equity
  • Strengthening strategic relationships with leading specialty outdoor retailers and key distribution partners across the region
  • Increasing footwear sell-through through stronger assortment planning, retail activation, technical education and premium merchandising
  • Improving forecasting accuracy, inventory productivity and commercial visibility across EMEA
  • Developing multi-year business plans by region, country and strategic account to identify and unlock sustainable growth opportunities
  • Elevating ARC’TERYX footwear visibility and credibility within the outdoor community through strategic retail initiatives, athlete engagement, product testing, field clinics and authentic consumer experiences
  • Building a high-performance regional sales culture focused on consultative selling, collaboration, coaching and long-term partnership
  • Strengthening distribution and channel discipline to ensure every commercial decision contributes to the long-term value of the brand

Are you our next Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA?

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sports Management or a related field
  • You bring 8–10+ years of international sales experience, ideally within premium outdoor, technical footwear or a related premium sporting goods environment
  • You have a proven track record managing wholesale business across multiple EMEA markets
  • You have a strong network within the European outdoor footwear and specialty retail community
  • You have experience negotiating complex international commercial agreements and developing long-term strategic customer partnerships
  • You have demonstrated success in delivering profitable growth while protecting premium brand positioning and disciplined distribution
  • You have strong commercial, analytical and strategic planning capabilities, with the ability to translate market opportunities into actionable business plans
  • You are an experienced people leader and coach, capable of inspiring sales teams, agencies and cross-functional partners toward ambitious objectives
  • You are comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures and markets, balancing regional consistency with local market needs
  • You have experience using Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms and/or retail analytics tools
  • You are fluent in English, with German highly desirable; French, Italian or Spanish would be advantageous
  • You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions
  • You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity and a fast-evolving business environment
  • You effectively balance autonomy and collaboration while working across international markets
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking, continuous improvement and a high-performance sales culture
  • You seek the best solutions, with an unwavering commitment to leaving it better
  • Your passion for commercial excellence is matched by your passion for getting outside and maintaining genuine credibility within the outdoor community

    • This role requires approximately 50-70% international travel throughout EMEA, with a focus on Europe, as well as approximately four annual journeys to Vancouver for key company moments such as Kick Off and Leadership Summit. You will regularly engage with specialty retailers, distributors, outdoor events, athlete activations, mountain festivals and international trade shows, while participating in product testing, field clinics and outdoor experiences to maintain deep product and consumer credibility.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance.
Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.
All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way.
Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.
Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.
Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

Role & Responsibilities:

The Mold Engineer, as part of the Underfoot Platforms Mold Team, is responsible for executing mold engineering activities in support of VF’s global footwear brands across development, commercialization, and production phases. The role focuses on mold development, engineering execution, and the management of supplier and vendor partnerships to ensure optimal performance, manufacturability, quality, cost, and delivery outcomes across brand product portfolios.

Serving as a key engineering interface for assigned brands, the role drives cross-functional collaboration with Brand Development, Sourcing, Quality, and Materials teams to translate innovative concepts into scalable, production-ready bottom units and molds. Regular, effective communication with Senior Manager and Director-level stakeholders is required. The position is expected to act as a technical thought partner, contributing innovative and practical engineering solutions to the organization.

.

  • Lead mold design and development from concept through production release across VF footwear brands, applying a “design for quality” approach.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure footwear designs are functional, manufacturable, cost-effective, and aligned with brand and aesthetic requirements.
  • Collaborate with tooling vendors and manufacturing partners to meet quality, cost, lead-time, and sustainability targets.
  • Provide technical expertise on mold engineering and manufacturing processes (e.g., injection, compression), aligned with material selections developed in collaboration with Polymer, Compounds, Underfoot Platforms, Materials Innovation, and Brand teams.
  • Execute mold trials, testing, and validation in close partnership with factories, Quality teams, and innovation partners.
  • Support sustainability objectives by implementing low-impact tooling methods and aligning mold engineering activities with VF Responsible Materials policies.
  • Travel to manufacturing partners in Asia and other regions to support mold development, troubleshooting, and production readiness.

Job Description:

This position is open to both remote & NY

WHO WE ARE:

Saks Global is the largest multi-brand luxury retailer in the world, comprising Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman and Saks OFF 5TH. Powered by our talented colleagues, we are redefining luxury shopping by offering each customer a personalized experience across our store network and e-commerce platforms. Through strong partnerships with the world’s most esteemed brands, cutting-edge technology and the industry’s most comprehensive luxury customer data, Saks Global is shaping the future of retail.

YOU WILL BE:

The VP, DMM Women’s Shoes play a crucial leadership role in developing and executing the merchandise strategy for designated divisions/categories.
